validation: Every gameplay/editor facet applies to all three planned native target families unless explicitly scoped. Nix shell evaluation or cross-compilation is not native execution proof. No Phase 0 observation claims Vulkan, Windows or macOS gameplay support.
mixed_mode_evidence: For a requirement spanning rendered and device-free execution, pair the corresponding platform runs: verify images on the rendering target and no-device operation, explicit renderer-unavailable errors and equivalent state on the headless target. An image-enabled assertion never requires a GPU in the device-denied run.
